sources.snippet: To address this challenge of 'physical interaction failure,' the team at PHANES AI, founded by Yang Shuo, a tenured professor at the Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, born in 1998, recently released their latest research achievement—the foundational tactile model, TouchWorld.

sources.title: TouchWorld: A Predictive and Reactive Tactile Foundation Model for ...
sources.snippet: We introduce TouchWorld, a predictive-and-reactive tactile foundation model for dexterous manipulation. TouchWorld uses a hierarchical policy that separates vision-language subtask planning, tactile world-model prediction, visuo-tactile goal-conditioned action generation, and high-frequency tactile residual refinement.
